title: Panthers "feel good" about first-round pick Monroe Freeling at right tackle

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Panthers "feel good" about first-round pick Monroe Freeling at right tackle
sources.description: The Panthers are set to open the season without either of their starting offensive tackles from 2025, but General Manager Dan Morgan didn't seem worried about that during a Wednesday press conference.
